input: what qualifies as damaged or defective
reference: A product with visible cuts, tears, broken parts, dents or scratches, a broken seal or leakage, missing parts or the wrong size, colour or item is damaged or defective.

input: steps to return a damaged product fulfilled by H&M
reference: Go to Your Orders, select the product, click Return/Replace items, choose a reason and follow the on-screen instructions.

input: returning a damaged item sold by a third-party seller
reference: Go to Your Orders, choose the item, select Contact seller and start a conversation in the Seller Messaging Assistant; if the seller does not respond in three business days the A-to-z Guarantee is available.

input: time window to initiate a replacement
reference: The replacement window matches the return window of the product category, for example 30 days.

input: I got the wrong product delivered
reference: You can return or request a replacement for the wrong item if it is in its original condition and packaging.
Incorrect or incomplete address, carrier could not reach you, nobody available, package refused or not collected from the pickup location.

input: what happens after a package cannot be delivered
reference: The carrier makes several attempts, then the package is returned to the H&M fulfilment centre or seller and the customer is notified.
Once H&M receives the returned package, the refund is processed to the original payment method.
